key_points: Insider sales by CEO, CFO, legal chief and others appear to be routine stock‑award tax settlements, involving only a few thousand shares each.
RBC lowered its price target for PG to $166, signaling modest near‑term caution.
Media chatter about whether PG will extend its dividend streak after earnings is speculative and not material.
PG shares rose ~1.6% in premarket trading on Oct 6, but the move lacks a clear catalyst.
Upcoming earnings preview (Barchart) will be the next potential driver; no surprise guidance or M&A news present.
